persons.name: Mukuṭānandana
persons.evidence: svavaṃśe putrapautrādipaṭhanārthe likhitaṃ mayāḥ (!) || || śubha || samvat 988 āṣāḍhaśuklayā paṃcamī bṛhaspativāra ṣūnūsakaumūlabdeyā śrīvajrācāryyamukuṭānamdana thva kriyāsamuccaya sabhūlacoya siddhaya kāgudinajula

notes: The author's name is corrupted to 'maṅkagadarppaṇa' for Jagaddarpaṇa, the well-known author of the Kriyāsamuccaya. The catalogue card lists the scribe as 'Vajrācārya Dhanasāgara', but the colophon text reads 'śrīvajrācāryyamukuṭānamdana'.
